articles.title: Binance tells EU users it will no longer provide services after failing to secure MiCA license
articles.snippet: A day after withdrawing its MiCA license application in Greece and saying it is ‘not leaving Europe,’ Binance notified users across the European Union that it will suspend some services.

articles.title: Story Protocol Rebrands as Data Network in AI Training Pivot After IP Token Falls 98%
articles.snippet: Intellectual property network Story Protocol has shifted its focus to a new opportunity in training data for artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Leaked Code Suggests Anthropic Is Preparing to Bring Fable 5 Back
articles.snippet: A leaker found new strings inside Claude Code that hint at weekly Fable 5 usage built into subscription plans, not sold separately as before.

articles.title: Fake Crypto Influencer Gets 15 Months for $1.4M Telegram Staking Fraud
articles.snippet: Noman Saleem impersonated crypto influencers on Telegram, luring victims into a fake staking scheme before vanishing with their funds.

articles.title: From Stellar to Canton: How Franklin Templeton Adopted Tokenization
articles.snippet: Roger Bayston, Head of Digital Assets at Franklin Templeton, unpacks how one of the world's largest asset managers embraced tokenization.
